components.text:
The Serenade of the Nether (internally: Lava Ritual) generates lava into a linked tank near the Master Ritual Stone, giving you a renewable lava source. Tier 0, costs $(blood)10,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.

Various Demon Will types can be channeled into this ritual via the Aura to change its behavior - it can be made particularly useful against denizens of the Nether, set nearby hostile mobs on a fire fuse (when the debuff ends, they do a wonderful impression of a firework), or grant the player Fire Resistance. Check the ritual's tooltip in-game (via the Ritual Diviner or a Divination Sigil) for the exact current bonuses on this branch.
